summary: BMO filed a Form 6-K with an exhibit announcing a routine quarterly dividend increase: common share dividend raised by $0.04 to $1.71/share (2% QoQ, 5% YoY). Also declared a preferred share dividend. This is a standard capital return action, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change is involved. The filing is a routine earnings/capital update by a foreign private issuer and does not warrant classification under any special-situations category.
